summary: Adds a codecs parameter to media types that can contain different formats, so the content type alone tells a receiver which codecs are needed to play it. Receivers can then decide whether to accept the content, transcode it, or fetch a codec. It is a standards-track document that was later replaced by RFC 6381.

eli5.summary: A video file can be like a box with a mystery inside. This adds a label telling which kind of player is needed, so you know before opening it.

questions: how to specify codecs in mime type
